title: 第8章 夜璇？迷烟放倒弄服！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“死吧！“

来人乃是北海二老中的老大阴雷手，阴天横，他是如何截获信息。想来与姬昊天在仙宫有内应或脱逃人员有关。

阴天横，一掌轰出。夜璇被迫迎战，对掌之下连退数步，面色苍白。

“能接我阴雷手一掌，不愧是苏若雪手下的顶级死士。还是个标致美人！“

他目光邪银，盯着她胸口。

夜璇气得脸色轻红，仍保持冷静。

老丑暗叫不好。原来是北海两兄弟。素闻焦孟不离，老大已现，老二必在附近。

念头刚落，二楼五声惨叫。门窗破裂，又一名老者飘落，双掌分拍而下。

“留活口。“北海老大急忙道。

老丑勉力一挡，气血翻腾，鲜血涌出。后天境玄力，在半步天人境北海玄掌前如萤火比皓月。

若非对方及时收手只用了两成力，这一掌足以让老丑再度穿越了！

北海老大：“这小美人我要了。二弟，让这丑鬼个回去传讯。告诉苏若雪，我们师兄弟也曾为她卖命，她既然归隐，就休怪我们翻脸了。“

老丑心中暗定：要自己传话，性命想来无虞了。

两人讲话之际，夜璇脚下猛地一蹬，破窗没入黑夜。北海老大狞笑跟上：“在我面前，还想跑？“

大堂只剩老丑和北海老二，玄阴手，阴无究。

“师兄说留你的命。“老二冷声，“滚吧！“

老丑躬身道：“多谢前辈活命之恩。”

说完往门口跑去。忽地，又感身后掌力袭来，阴冷覆背。

他急运玄力护背，借势冲入黑暗。

“嘿嘿，丑鬼，你中我玄掌，十日内，必死无疑，送信去吧！“

老丑体内气血翻涌，寒气透骨。勉强运转功体，踉跄前行。

一个时辰后，林中盘腿调息，浑身蒸汽弥漫。

好在纯阳体，本就天生克制寒毒，又叠加混元无极功，方才好了小半。

“好个狠毒的阴老二！”心中怒骂，但也无可奈何，起身，继续赶路。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Die!"

The person who came was Yin Lei Shou, the eldest of the two elders in Beihai. Yin Tianheng, how did he intercept the information.It probably has something to do with Ji Haotian having a spy or an escapee in the Immortal Palace.

The sky was cloudy and he blasted out with a palm.Ye Xuan was forced to fight, and took several steps back under the opponent's palm, her face turned pale.

"You are worthy of being Su Ruoxue's top warrior if you can receive a blow from my Yin Thunder Hand. She is also a beautiful woman!"

He stared at her chest with evil eyes.

Ye Xuan's face turned slightly red with anger, but she still remained calm.

Lao Chou secretly cried out.It turned out to be two brothers from Beihai.I have always heard that Jiao Meng is not leaving, the boss has appeared, and the second brother must be nearby.

As soon as the thought came to an end, there were five screams from the second floor.The door and window were broken, and another old man fell down, clapping his hands down.

"Keep alive." Beihai Boss said hurriedly.

Lao Chou tried his best to block it, his blood boiling and blood gushing out.The profound strength of the acquired heaven realm is as bright as a firefly compared to the bright moon in front of the Beihai Xuanzhang of the half-step heaven and human realm.

If the other party hadn't stopped his hand in time and used only 20% of his strength, this palm would have been enough to make Lao Chou travel through time again!

The boss of Beihai said: "I want this little beauty. Second brother, let this ugly ghost go back for questioning. Tell Su Ruoxue that our senior brothers have also worked hard for her. Since she has gone into seclusion, don't blame us for falling out."

Lao Chou secretly decided that if he had to pass on the message himself, his life would be safe.

While the two were talking, Ye Xuan kicked her foot violently, breaking the window and falling into the night.The boss of Beihai followed up with a ferocious smile: "Are you still trying to run in front of me?"

Only Lao Chou and Beihai's second son, Xuanyin Shou and Yin Wuju, were left in the lobby.

"Senior brother said to spare your life." The second brother said coldly, "Go away!"

Lao Chou bowed and said, "Thank you, senior, for surviving."

After saying that, he ran towards the door.Suddenly, he felt the force of his palm coming from behind him again, and a cold feeling covered his back.

He quickly used his profound energy to protect his back and took advantage of the situation to rush into the darkness.

"Hey, ugly ghost, you have been hit by my mysterious palm and you will definitely die within ten days. Send the message!"

Lao Chou's body was filled with qi and blood, and the coldness penetrated his bones.He barely moved his body and stumbled forward.

An hour later, Lin Zhong was crossing his legs and adjusting his breath, and his whole body was filled with steam.

Fortunately, the pure yang body is naturally capable of restraining cold poison, and with the addition of the Hunyuan Wuji Kung Fu, it was only half cured.

"What a vicious bastard!" He cursed angrily in his heart, but he had no choice but to get up and continue on his way.
